# By Lado

> Hair extensions studio in Leeuwarden (Friesland, the Netherlands) by Quinty Kant. Natural, colour-matched extensions with a "your own hair first" approach and honest advice.

## Services
- Personal consultation: hair analysis, colour matching, advice, tailored price
- Extension methods: see https://bylado.nl/extensions (only methods confirmed by the studio are listed there)
- Maintenance / move-up, removal, extensions for weddings and events
- Extension check (quiz): https://bylado.nl/extension-check

## Location
Leeuwarden, Friesland, the Netherlands — studio by appointment.
